name: shiki-browser-extension
description: Shiki Capture — browser extension dev harness

scripts.dev: npm run host:build && npm run host:install && node scripts/launch-chrome.mjs
scripts.lint: node --check src/background.js && node --check src/popup.js && node --check src/content.js && echo "js syntax ok"
scripts.validate: node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('manifest.json','utf8')); console.log('manifest ok')" && npm run lint
scripts.build:zip: zip -r shiki-capture-0.1.0.zip manifest.json src/ icons/ -x '*.DS_Store' && echo 'zip ready' && ls -lh shiki-capture-0.1.0.zip
